{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve top, hip length, ivory (#F2EDE4), fine merino wool

Trousers: straight-leg, high-waisted, full length to the ankle, charcoal (#3B3F45), wool-blend flannel
Coat: straight single-breasted, mid-calf length, with a storm collar, navy (#1F2A3C), water-repellent wool blend with down-fill lining
Ankle boots: low block heel, lugged rubber sole, black (#1A1A1A), waterproof treated leather with warm fleece lining
Socks: thick, mid-calf, heather grey (#8A8D91), merino wool

This outfit keeps the neat office look of a refined knit and tailored trousers, while the thermal layers underneath handle a long walk in deep frost. The long, water-repellent coat blocks wind and snow, and the scarf, beanie and gloves cover the areas that lose heat fastest. Waterproof leather boots with a lugged sole give grip on icy pavement and resist road salt, and they wipe clean easily when you arrive.
